description: This Java class defines a command object for deleting an attribute from a thing within the Eclipse Ditto project. It encapsulates the logic for creating, serializing, and validating a delete attribute command, including handling JSON conversion, validation of attribute pointers, and managing related headers and identifiers.

classes.name: DeleteAttribute
classes.description: Defines a command for deleting a specific attribute from a thing, including validation, JSON serialization, and deserialization methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DeleteAttribute with the provided thing ID, attribute JSON pointer, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a DeleteAttribute command from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the attribute to delete.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing associated with this delete attribute command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the attribute resource being deleted.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the delete command's payload into JSON, respecting schema version and predicate filtering.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of this command (delete).

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of DeleteAttribute with updated headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization (returns false).

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the command instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object based on internal fields.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equals to check class compatibility.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command.
